digest.en: Ukrainian gymnast Sofia Shaparenko wins gold at the European Championships after losing a leg in a Russian strike, while the White House signals that Trump is considering new strikes on Iran. The Senate moves forward with Ukraine arms packages, while a US lawmaker urges Taiwan to pass a drone bill.

articles.title: 10-Year-Old Ukrainian Gymnast Wins Gold After Losing Leg In Russian Strike
